purpose: Document distinct English/local-language search evidence, first-party local custody scope, direct anonymous route results and geometry-only limits.
assessment: Utah County Government’s official GIS portal advertises its parcel map and nightly-updated Tax Parcel data combining Recorder parcel linework with Assessor detail. The official county `TaxParcels_mobile` MapServer layer 21 (`live_parcel_polygon`, 16K scale product) returned one full polygon at the unchanged WUP point with safe fields only. A separate Provo-hosted detailed polygon layer returned zero at that point and documents redundant condo geometries; therefore the county alternate is a concrete exact-point geometry candidate, but its scale-specific behavior and source consistency require root qualification before runtime. Runtime remains unqualified because the successful result is a 16K map-service layer and the separate detailed Provo service has a contradictory empty result.
registryAssessment: Utah County GIS Division publishes a countywide Tax Parcel dataset based on Recorder parcel linework and Assessor data, refreshed nightly. The official county viewer service includes Provo and returned one safe full polygon at the exact WUP point; this establishes public geometry evidence, not production feed fitness.
